messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide to help you get your acoustic guitar sold quickly and at a fair price: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Clean & Tune** | Give the guitar a quick wash (soft cloth, mild cleaner) and tune it to standard tuning (E‑A‑D‑G‑B‑E). | A well‑presented, properly tuned instrument looks more appealing to buyers. | | **2. Take Quality Photos** | • Use natural light.
• Capture front, back, neck, headstock, sound hole, and any flaws.
• Include a reference object (e.g., a coin or a ruler). | Clear images reduce buyer hesitation and help set realistic expectations. | | **3. Write a Detailed Description** | • Brand, model, year, wood type, finish, serial number.
• Condition notes (scratches, repairs, original parts).
• Any accessories (case, strap, picks).
• Reason for selling. | Transparency builds trust and reduces post‑sale disputes. | | **4. Research Pricing** | • Check completed listings on eBay, Reverb, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, and local music stores.
• Compare similar models, age, and condition. | Competitive pricing attracts offers while ensuring you don’t undersell. | | **5. Choose Your Selling Platform(s)** | • **Online Marketplaces** – eBay, Reverb, Etsy (for vintage), Amazon (if new).
• **Local Classifieds** – Craigslist, Gumtree, Nextdoor.
• **Social Media** – Facebook Marketplace, Instagram (use hashtags like #forsale, #guitar).
• **Consignment Shops** – Local music stores or specialty consignment shops. | Multiple platforms increase visibility; consignment shops handle shipping and may fetch higher prices. | | **6. Set Shipping Options** | • Offer local pickup for convenience.
• For long‑distance sales, use a reputable courier (UPS, FedEx, USPS) with insurance and tracking.
• Pack the guitar in a padded case or custom foam box. | Proper packaging protects the instrument and gives buyers peace of mind. | | **7. Communicate Promptly** | Respond to inquiries within 24 hrs.
Provide additional photos or details if requested. | Quick replies keep potential buyers engaged and signal professionalism. | | **8. Negotiate Wisely** | • Decide your lowest acceptable price beforehand.
• Be prepared to counter‑offer but stay firm on your minimum. | Knowing your bottom line prevents you from accepting a lower offer than you’re comfortable with. | | **9. Finalize the Sale** | • Use secure payment methods (PayPal, Venmo, bank transfer).
• Provide a receipt or invoice. | Secure transactions protect both parties and create a record for tax purposes. | | **10. Ship & Track** | • Label the package clearly.
• Send the tracking number to the buyer.
• Keep the receipt and tracking info for your records. | Tracking ensures delivery confirmation and helps resolve disputes if the package is lost. | ### Quick Tips - **Timing:** Listings posted mid‑week (Tuesday–Thursday) often receive more views than weekend posts. - **Safety:** Meet in public places for local pickups; bring a friend if possible. - **Legal:** If you’re in the U.S., keep a copy of the sale for tax reporting (you may need to report capital gains/losses). ### Example Listing Template ``` Title: 2005 Martin D-28 Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition – $650 Description: - Brand/Model: Martin D-28 - Year: 2005 - Wood: Spruce top, Mahogany back & sides - Finish: Natural (no scratches) - Serial #: 12345678 - Accessories: Original case, strap, picks - Condition: Played lightly, no cracks, fully functional - Reason for selling: Upgrading to a 12‑string Photos: [Attach 5–7 high‑resolution images] Price: $650 (negotiable) Contact: Email me at example@example.com or DM on Instagram @yourhandle Shipping: Local pickup available; otherwise insured shipping via UPS/FedEx. ``` Feel free to adapt this template to fit your guitar’s specifics. Good luck with your sale!
